verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents generally available sharding that scales a single namespace up to 256TB, and an object-storage architecture with an NVMe/memory compute cache that it says scales queries to petabyte scale. That is first-party evidence of scaling beyond a single node. However, the sharding evidence is a one-line roadmap entry with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on sharding configuration and behavior (shard count, rebalancing, node topology), detail on how distributed compute scales out, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-node scaling.
